# Full task IDs returned by JSON can be used to address the task in a new process.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe add 'Stable handle' --state todo --json
json
capture-task-id
stdout '"id": "wft_[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}"'

exec tuck$exe show $TASK_ID --json
json
stdout '"title": "Stable handle"'
stdout '"number": "001"'

exec tuck$exe rename $TASK_ID 'Addressed by ID' --json
json
stdout '"title": "Addressed by ID"'
exists tasks/todo/001-addressed-by-id.md

! exec tuck$exe show 'wft_invalid'
stderr 'use its number or ID'
